object.description: Open a repository with the documents DOC and PARENT. Put git conflict markers in DOC's only object file. Expected: the list still shows DOC as loading. Choose Refresh. Expected: DOC is shown as failed to load. Put the file back as it was and choose Refresh again. Expected: DOC is shown as loading.
